items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: b14g’s Recorded TVL Nearly Halved to $135M by Nov. 24
headlines.summary: DefiLlama’s recorded Bitcoin balance fell 31% over 30 days, while its implied dollar value per coin fell about 24%.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
headlines.summary: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

headlines.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
headlines.summary: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

headlines.title: Sky Proposes Urgent 25M USDS Transfer to Foundation
headlines.summary: The funds were already earmarked for the Sky Frontier Foundation. The proposal seeks to accelerate debt repayment as stUSDS withdrawals remain unavailable.

headlines.title: Convex TVL Falls 33%, More Than Twice Curve's Decline
headlines.summary: DefiLlama's daily snapshots show a $188 million contraction over 30 days. The change in dollar value is not a measure of withdrawals.

headlines.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
headlines.summary: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

headlines.title: Sky’s Rune Pursues stUSDS Deal as Withdrawal Squeeze Persists
headlines.summary: The Sky co-founder previously said he owed about 77 million USDS and was exploring direct SKY sales to institutional investors to fund repayment.

headlines.title: Base Drives Morpho Blue’s 66% Monthly Fee Increase
headlines.summary: Base accounted for 83% of the increase in a metric combining borrower interest and liquidation bonuses—not Morpho’s own revenue.

headlines.title: Hyperliquid’s HYPE will join bitcoin, ether and more in Franklin Templeton’s crypto ETF
headlines.summary: Franklin Templeton's Crypto Index ETF (EZPZ) will add Hyperliquid's HYPE token effective Dec. 1, according to an SEC prospectus supplement.

headlines.title: How Anthropic's Tokens Traded Through Their First Sessions and Weekend
headlines.summary: Anthropic's eight tokens tracked Nasdaq within about 1% at every close in their first three sessions. Underneath, the price was set on a perpetual that traded 24 times their combined volume, and the first weekend left two order books for…

headlines.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
headlines.summary: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

headlines.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
headlines.summary: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

headlines.title: Aave Labs publicly launches savings app as balances top $63 million
headlines.summary: Aave App supports bank transfers in the U.S., UK, and EEA, plus stablecoin deposits across eight networks.

headlines.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
headlines.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

headlines.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
headlines.summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

headlines.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
headlines.summary: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

headlines.title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
headlines.summary: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

headlines.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
headlines.summary: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

headlines.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana joint venture for stablecoin payments and tokenization
headlines.summary: The entity will pursue initiatives in stablecoin-based payments, financial and real-world asset tokenization, and onchain asset management.

headlines.title: Hong Kong Monetary Authority launches digital asset platform for tokenized debt securities
headlines.summary: HSBC, Standard Chartered, Bank of China (Hong Kong), DBS, and six other banks are the platform’s first direct participants.

headlines.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
headlines.summary: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

headlines.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
headlines.summary: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

headlines.title: SBI, SMFG Launch Solana Venture for Onchain Finance
headlines.summary: The former SBI R3 Japan will target stablecoin payments and tokenized assets, establishing Japanese use cases before expanding overseas.

headlines.title: HKMA Launches CMU Platform for Tokenized Bond Settlement
headlines.summary: Ten banks have joined the permissioned system, while connections to tokenized deposits and regulated stablecoins remain on its expansion roadmap.

headlines.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
headlines.summary: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

headlines.title: French Senate Rejects €100,000 Crypto Wallet Rule
headlines.summary: Senators also rejected proposals to tax gains on swaps into certain stablecoins and extend the exit tax to crypto. The 2027 budget remains under debate.

headlines.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
headlines.summary: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

headlines.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
headlines.summary: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

headlines.title: Morpho Borrow Rate Doubled Amid Spark Liquidity Pullback
headlines.summary: Spark cut its position in a Base lending market by about 468 million USDC. The pool's daily-average borrow rate rose above 10% before easing.
